subtitle: All your remaining quotas in one place. Get notified when it’s time to return.
defaultIntervalHelp: Applies to new accounts, without changing existing accounts.
advancedIntervals: Show fast monitoring intervals for Claude
claudeWarning: Check Claude at most every 5 minutes. Faster checks can cause prolonged rate limits.
pushHelp: Subscribe to low quota, recovery and expired credentials alerts. Requires HTTPS or localhost; on iOS, add the app to your Home Screen first.
installHelp: Install from your browser menu or add to your Home Screen. The interface opens offline; current data and actions require a connection.
serverHelp: Monitoring and push pause while the server sleeps. Connection and data freshness are shown on the dashboard.
footer: Quota checks and notifications. No request proxying.
label: Display name
thresholdHelp: Notify when remaining quota crosses a threshold. Recovery must be higher than the low quota threshold.
loginSecurity: Credentials are stored only on your server. Never paste passwords or access tokens here.
authorizationInput: Authorization code or full redirect URL
deleteHelp: This deletes the account’s credentials and history and cannot be undone.
pinHelp: Enter this server’s access PIN. It is stored only for this tab’s session.
offline: Offline · live data and actions unavailable
unreachable: Server unreachable or sleeping · last connected {time}
neverConnected: Unable to reach the server. Check your connection or wake the service.
staleConnection: Connection stale · the server may be sleeping
emptyHelp: Add an account and connect to its provider. Only real provider data will appear.
noData: No quota data yet. Connect your account or check now.
resetPending: Reset time passed · awaiting new data
trendEmpty: Trend appears after the first successful check.
trendLabel: Remaining quota history from {start} to {end}; latest {value}
thresholdInvalid: Recovery threshold must be higher than the low quota threshold.
fastWarning: Sub-minute checks increase API calls and rate-limit risk.
deviceInstructions: Open the authorization page and enter this code. This page will update automatically after authorization.
pasteInstructions: Open the authorization page, approve access, then paste the returned code or the entire redirect URL below. Include the state value when present.
callbackInstructions: Approve access in the authorization page. Your browser will return to the local service.
loginExpired: Login expired. Close this window and start again.
pushUnavailable: Push is unavailable. Use a supported browser with HTTPS or localhost.
pushDenied: Notifications are blocked. Enable permission in your browser’s site settings.
pushNone: No subscribed devices received the test. Check the subscription and notification permissions.
installUnavailable: Use your browser menu to install this app.
networkError: Unable to reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
genericError: The operation could not be completed. Try again.
validationError: Check the entered values and try again.
authRequired: The access PIN is required or incorrect.
notFound: This item no longer exists. Refresh the dashboard.
rateLimited: Too many requests. Wait before trying again.
error.UPSTREAM_ERROR: The provider is temporarily unavailable. Previous data is retained.
error.UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT: The provider request timed out. The server will retry.
error.UPSTREAM_SCHEMA: The provider returned an unsupported quota format.
error.RATE_LIMITED: The provider rate-limited this account. Checks are backed off automatically.
error.LOGIN_DENIED: Authorization was denied. Start again if you wish to connect.
error.LOGIN_STATE: Authorization state does not match. Restart login and use the correct redirect URL.
error.LOGIN_INPUT: The authorization code or URL is invalid. Paste the complete result from the authorization page.
error.LOGIN_MODE: This login method is unavailable in the current deployment.
error.LOGIN_NOT_FOUND: Login session no longer exists. Start again.
error.LOGIN_PORT_BUSY: The callback port is in use. Close the conflicting CLI or use device login.
error.PUSH_FAILED: Push delivery failed. Check device subscriptions.
error.INVALID_ORIGIN: The request origin was rejected. Open the configured dashboard URL.
error.TOO_LARGE: The submitted data is too large.
